title: Design and Realization of an Open-Hardware Agarose Gel and Chemiluminescence Imaging Device with Open-Source Control Software: Preliminary Results
content: This paper presents design, realization and preliminary test stages of an open hardware hybrid agarose gel and chemiluminescence imaging equipment which is one of the most important devices required in educational and research laboratories of DNA/RNA analysis, cancer drug research and etc. The paper gives details of mechanical, electrical realization steps and developed control software; aiming an open-science hardware platform. Device control software is implemented on Raspberry Pi 4B and imaging is achieved via Raspberry Pi High Quality Camera Module with 16 mm focus lens. All the components for realization are chosen from off-the shelf components or designed from scratch via repeatable processes (e.g. 3D printing, CNC manufacturing). Similar to commercial gel imagers, the device is able to image agarose gels with adjustable parameters (e.g. brightness, contrast, exposure time) under digitally controlled epi (red, blue, green) and trans-illumination (red, blue, green and white) modes and membranes for chemiluminescence imaging up-to 10 minutes of exposure time.
